role: A post-open representation-capacity diagnostic on the already consumed BLASTNet Case 7 tails. It is not a deployment method, predictor, prospective external confirmation, or resource measurement.
scientific_question: At the same total dimension 64 as the failed v236 global rank-64 tail space and v238 fixed-octant direct sum, does transforming every training tail into the symmetric coordinate system of its frozen geometry-Jacobi PCGLS preconditioner and mapping the common rank-64 space through the held-out rig geometry recover every held-out rig?
physical_hypothesis: The K16-minus-fixed-Low64-K11 tail may be shared in the symmetric PCGLS variable u=M_g^(-1/2)x even when the physical-field tail x is not shared, because each rig uses a different exact geometry-only Jacobi inverse M_g. The unique primary tests only this coordinate explanation.

not_computed_before_freeze: any v239 per-cell residual, tail summary, or decision
post_open_boundary.claim_limit: A pass is only post-open Case 7 geometry-coordinate representation headroom and cannot authorize a predictor without a separate result-before-training contract.

sealed_inputs.v236_root_role: private independently validated global-tail attribution tree outside Git

frozen_data_and_geometry.geometry_source: Rebuild the same thirteen v209 clean reported nine-camera rigs and exact geometry-Jacobi maps already bound and independently checked by v235.
frozen_data_and_geometry.v235_source_closure_rule: Every path and inventory in the sealed v235 formal source_closure_before must still match the current repository before geometry reconstruction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.v235_jacobi_identity_rule: Every rebuilt inverse diagonal SHA256 must equal the corresponding sealed v235 formal jacobi_geometry_setup entry.

unique_primary.name: loro_symmetric_jacobi_canonical_rank64
unique_primary.preconditioner: For rig g, M_g is exactly the frozen normalized inverse diagonal used by v235 geometry-Jacobi PCGLS: median(diag(A_g^T A_g)_positive) / max(diag(A_g^T A_g), 1e-6*max_positive).
unique_primary.symmetric_coordinate: Because x=M_g^(1/2)u, transform each physical tail to u=M_g^(-1/2)x by elementwise division by sqrt(M_g). No further normalization, clipping, centering, weighting, or support change is allowed.
unique_primary.folds: For held-out rig h, stack the 42 canonical tails from each of the other twelve rigs into one 504x8192 matrix. All 42 tails from h are excluded.
unique_primary.canonical_basis: Use the uncentered rank-64 principal subspace of the 504x8192 training matrix.
unique_primary.heldout_physical_span: Map each canonical basis row through x=M_h^(1/2)u by elementwise multiplication by sqrt(M_h), then orthonormalize the resulting 64-row physical span without changing the span.
unique_primary.formal_solver: Sample-Gram eigendecomposition for the canonical basis followed by economy QR of the transposed mapped physical span.
unique_primary.independent_solver: Direct economy SVD of every 504x8192 canonical training matrix followed by direct SVD orthonormalization of each mapped 64x8192 physical span in a separate program that does not import the formal implementation.
unique_primary.oracle_projection: Project each held-out truth tail independently into the held-out geometry-mapped physical span. Coefficients are truth-aware and nondeployable; this tests span capacity only.
forbidden_variants: centering, weighting, smoothing, clipping, or support changes
normal-matrix powers beyond the frozen diagonal PCGLS map
changed v235 depth, basis, inverse, Jacobi floor, regularizer, or threshold
CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU rescue

controls.sealed_global_loro_rank64: Use the independently validated v236 global rank-64 residuals and summaries without recomputation or reinterpretation.
controls.sealed_fixed_low64_span: Use the independently validated v236 fixed Low64 control residuals and summaries without recomputation or reinterpretation.
controls.sealed_fixed_octant_rank8x8: Use the independently validated v238 negative decision only as parent scope; it is not recomputed or compared as a passing control.
controls.fairness: The primary and global control both have total dimension 64 and use the same held-out rigs, tails, truth-aware projection role, and gates. The only scientific change is the frozen geometry-Jacobi coordinate map.

decision_order: Any source, input, parent-decision, v235-source-closure, geometry, Jacobi-hash, shape, finite, rank, orthogonality, span-reconstruction, camera-permutation, sealed-control, formal-independent numeric, output-seal, or discrete-decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE7_JACOBI_CANONICAL_TAIL_CAPACITY_V239.

If the unique Jacobi-canonical rank-64 primary fails any all-frame or late-frame gate in any held-out rig, conclude FAIL_CASE7_JACOBI_CANONICAL_TAIL_SUBSPACE_CAPACITY_V239 and close only this symmetric geometry-Jacobi canonicalization.
If the primary passes but the sealed global rank-64 control also passes, conclude PASS_CASE7_JACOBI_CANONICAL_CAPACITY_NOT_GEOMETRY_ISOLATED_V239.

Only if the primary passes every held-out-rig gate while both sealed v236 controls fail may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE7_JACOBI_CANONICAL_TAIL_CAPACITY_HEADROOM_V239. This does not authorize deployment coefficients or an algorithm claim.
